patch.description: displayName, username (2–32 characters, lower case letters, digits, ., -, _; 400 with code username_invalid, 409 with username_taken; 403 in demo mode), email, password, avatarUrl, alarmChannels, alarmEmail, discordWebhookUrl, customWebhookUrl, notifyBeforeMinutes, retention (doneTasks, taskTrash, triageTrash, noteTrash, listDone: days selected from 7, 14, 30, 90, 365, 730, or 0 = never; always all five, 400 on other values or for 0 if the server has disabled "never"), voiceInput ("" = Whisper server, browser), voiceLanguage (language spoken into the microphone: "" (default) or auto = Whisper detects it, app = the app language, or one of Whisper's language codes such as ru; 400 for unknown codes), language (de, en, es, fr, it or "" = follow the browser, then the server's default; 400 for other codes; GET /auth/me returns it as language), doneRetentionDays (legacy single field for retention.doneTasks). GET /auth/me includes retention and retentionNeverAllowed. notificationSettings (paused, includeOwnWatched, events.{due,shared,assigned,mentioned,taskCreated,taskDone,watched}.{email,discord,webhook,push}, dailySummary.{enabled,time,email,discord}) for notifications. New email or password requires currentPassword (403 if incorrect, 429 if login locked; wrong guesses count like failed logins). A new email (login address, 409 if taken) or an alarmEmail other than the login address is not taken at once: it waits for the click on a link mailed to it and shows as pendingEmail / pendingAlarmEmail, the old address stays in use (without a mail server it keeps waiting; emailLinks says whether links can go out). The login address as alarmEmail applies at once. avatarUrl is "", an emoji or an uploaded picture as data:image/(png|jpeg|webp);base64,… up to 300 KB (400 otherwise); after password change, other devices are logged out and the new token is returned in the X-Session-Token header

post.summary: Move a bullet with its children into another note
post.description: {blockId, targetId, clientId}: copies the bullet with its sub-bullets to the end of note targetId (through the target's sync operations, open editors follow live) and moves links of tasks and subtasks on these checkboxes along → {targetId, targetTitle, rootId, moved} (moved: new block ID in the target → block ID in the source). The server does not modify the source note; the editor removes the branch itself (or leaves a link [[Title#^rootId]] when extracting into an existing note), so Ctrl+Z works. Requires write permission on both notes; 400 same note, 404 bullet not found, 409 someone else is typing in the branch. The earlier address POST /documents/{id}/move still works

post.summary: Undo moving a bullet into another note
post.description: Body: the result of branches/move plus clientId: removes the branch from the target note again and gives the task links back to the source note's checkboxes (which the editor restores by its own undo)

post.summary: Turn a bullet with its children into a note of its own
post.description: {blockId, clientId}: creates a new note from the bullet and its sub-bullets; the bullet stays the note's first bullet (title = its text without hashtags, "New note" for drawings, images, code and other bullets without usable text; same folder, shares inherited, non-owner recipient receives write permission) → {document, link}. The server does not modify the source note; the editor itself replaces the sub-tree with link (standard local change, Ctrl+Z possible). Requires write permission; 409 if someone else is currently typing in the branch; 400 if the bullet is now only a link to a note (optionally with hashtags)

post.summary: Undo turning a bullet into a note
post.description: Moves extracted note {id} back to trash (creator only)

post.summary: Bring a linked note back into this one
post.description: {blockId}: counterpart to extract for a bullet consisting solely of a link to a note ([[Note#doc_id]] or older [[Note]], optionally with hashtags) → {sourceId, content, head?, blocks}: text for the bullet (title plus hashtags) and note bullets with new IDs (level 0 = directly beneath the bullet). For a note made by extract (a single top-level bullet that names the note), head is that bullet: it replaces the link bullet (type and props), content is its text plus the link's hashtags, and blocks are its children. The linked note is moved to trash; undo with POST /documents/{sourceId}/restore. The editor modifies the source note locally. 400 not a link bullet (a link to a single bullet, [[Note#^id]], does not count), 404 note not found, 403 another user's note, 409 still referenced by other notes

get.description: People whose names you may see: everyone you may share with (findable: true, only while people search is on) and everyone you work on something together with (findable: false); /collaborators without yourself (sharing-and-permissions.md). Only public profile per person: id, username, displayName, avatarUrl, findable – no e-mail address and no private details (webhooks, alarm email, role, organizations). Member and share lists of notes, folders, lists, task lists and groups carry names only, no addresses

Only in server mode for voice recognition: multipart/form-data with file (recording, e.g. WebM/Opus or MP4/AAC) → {text}. 404 without STT_URL, 413 too large, 429 hourly rate limit, 503 busy, 502 Whisper error (details in log)

post.summary: Capture into the Quick Dump, a task list or a list via webhook
post.description: Ingest via webhook, key as X-API-Key (recommended), Bearer or ?token= (URL parameter accepts only API keys, no session tokens). Body: title/content/text/message, priority, source, tags, dueDate; target (or type): triage (default, inbox), task (optional taskListId), list_item (listId, category, quantity). Plain text body is treated as content. 403 without matching scope or without write permission on the list. The alternative field names (title/content/text/message, dueDate/due_date, target/type) are accepted on purpose, so the payloads of different tools work without a mapping
